relationship_description: Albert Garcia is the son of former Bataan governor and congressman Enrique 'Tet' Garcia Jr., both prominent members of the Garcia political dynasty in Bataan.
Albert Garcia and Jose Enrique S. Garcia III are brothers, both serving as governors and congressmen of Bataan, part of the Garcia political dynasty.
Ace Cerilles is married to Aurora Cerilles, both of whom have served as governor and congresswoman of Zamboanga del Sur, forming the Cerilles political dynasty.
Ace Cerilles is the father of Jhong Cerilles, who has also served as a public official in Zamboanga del Sur, continuing the Cerilles political dynasty.
